title.zh: 企業人類學與權力動態戰略 (CEO/CHRO 社會學視角)

slide_title.zh: 戰略失效與文化盲區 (SCQA & The Sociological Mandate)
slide_title.en: Strategic Failure & The Cultural Blind Spot (SCQA)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：董事會已核准了完美的 [數位轉型/併購整合] 戰略，並配置了充足的財務預算與頂尖的技術基礎設施
衝突 (Complication)：戰略在落地時遭遇無法解釋的嚴重延宕，各部門表面配合但暗中抵制，「制度性慣性 (Institutional Inertia)」正在吞噬資本回報率
戰略訴求 (The Ask)：提議跳脫純財務與工程視角，啟動「組織社會學/企業人類學」深度診斷，懇請授權重塑企業非正式權力結構與文化誘因
en: Situation: The Board has fully funded and mandated a flawless [Digital Transformation/M&A Integration] strategy, backed by state-of-the-art infrastructure.

Complication: Execution is paralyzed by inexplicable friction. Departments exhibit 'malicious compliance' (surface agreement, covert resistance), and 'Institutional Inertia' is destroying projected ROI.

The Ask: Proposing a pivot from purely financial/engineering lenses to execute an 'Organizational Sociology & Anthropology' diagnostic. Requesting the mandate to re-engineer informal power structures and cultural incentives.

speaker_notes.zh: 各位董事，我們手上的戰略藍圖完美無缺，但為什麼推不動？因為『文化把戰略當早餐吃』。當我們試圖推動變革時，我們挑戰的不只是流程，而是員工的社會資本與安全感。表面的 KPI 救不了我們。今天的提案，是要用社會學與人類學的視角，像解剖一樣，切開公司的『文化盲區』，找出到底是誰在暗中踩煞車，並用更深層的誘因讓他們鬆腳。
speaker_notes.en: Members of the Board, our strategic blueprints are mathematically flawless, yet execution is failing. Why? Because 'culture eats strategy for breakfast.' When we mandate change, we aren't just altering workflows; we are threatening social capital and psychological safety. Surface-level KPIs cannot fix this. Today's mandate deploys sociological and anthropological diagnostics to dissect our 'cultural blind spots,' identifying the covert gatekeepers applying the brakes and rewiring the deep incentives required to release them.

slide_title.zh: 影子組織圖與非正式權力網絡 (The Shadow Org Chart)
slide_title.en: The Shadow Org Chart & Informal Power Networks

zh: 解構權力 (Deconstructing Power)：捨棄官方的「層級組織圖」，運用社會網絡分析 (SNA) 繪製出企業真實運作的「影子組織圖 (Shadow Org Chart)」
辨識關鍵節點 (Identifying Hubs & Gatekeepers)：找出那些職稱不高、但實質掌握資訊流動與跨部門話語權的「文化意見領袖 (Cultural Brokers)」
招安與賦權 (Co-opting Resistance)：將變革的成敗綁定在這些非正式領袖身上，將他們從潛在的「破壞者」轉化為變革的「傳教士 (Change Agents)」
en: Deconstructing Power: Discarding the official hierarchical org chart. Utilizing Social Network Analysis (SNA) to map the 'Shadow Org Chart'—how influence and information actually flow.
Identifying Hubs & Gatekeepers: Pinpointing the 'Cultural Brokers'—individuals who may lack elite titles but possess immense informal authority and cross-silo influence.
Co-opting Resistance: Surgically anchoring the success of the transformation to these informal leaders, converting them from covert saboteurs into highly incentivized 'Change Agents.'

speaker_notes.zh: 如果你只看公司名片上的職稱來推動專案，你一定會失敗。每個公司都有兩張組織圖：一張是掛在牆上的，一張是隱形的『影子組織圖』。那些在茶水間能影響跨部門決策的老員工，才是真正的『節點 (Hub)』。我們必須精準定位這些『文化意見領袖』，不要用強權壓迫他們，而是要賦予他們特權，把他們招安成我們變革的傳教士。
speaker_notes.en: If you drive change based solely on official titles, you will fail. Every enterprise has two org charts: the one on the wall, and the invisible 'Shadow Org Chart.' The veteran employee whose word carries weight across departments in the breakroom is the true 'Hub.' We must surgically identify these 'Cultural Brokers.' Instead of crushing them with executive authority, we co-opt them, granting them unique status to convert them into our most powerful Change Agents.

slide_title.zh: 次文化衝突與高階調解機制 (Subculture Friction & Mediation)

zh: 次文化碰撞 (Subculture Collisions)：剖析傳統核心業務（現金牛的保守文化）與新創/AI部門（敏捷容錯文化）之間的深層社會學對立
語言與語境翻譯 (Contextual Translation)：引入高階調解 (Mediation) 技巧，打破雙方的「確認偏誤 (Confirmation Bias)」，將技術語言與營運語言轉化為共同的商業價值
結構性破冰 (Structural Ice-breaking)：建立跨次文化的「混合特種部隊 (Hybrid Squads)」，透過共同承擔高壓的短期專案，強迫建立新的社會信任資本
en: Subculture Collisions: Diagnosing the deep sociological friction between legacy core operations (conservative, zero-defect culture) and innovation/AI units (agile, fail-fast culture).

Contextual Translation (Mediation): Deploying advanced Mediation tactics to shatter 'Confirmation Bias.' Translating the dialect of engineering and the dialect of operations into a unified commercial language.
Structural Ice-breaking: Forging cross-cultural 'Hybrid Squads.' Forcing these conflicting tribes to co-own high-stakes, short-term sprints to aggressively synthesize new social trust.

speaker_notes.zh: 在併購或創新轉型中，最致命的是『次文化衝突』。做傳統製造的，信奉『零缺陷』；做 AI 的，信奉『快速試錯』。這兩群人坐在一起，就像說著不同語言的部落。這時，高階主管必須具備『專業調解員』的能力。我們不能只講大道理，我們要進行『語境翻譯』，並把他們關在同一個敏捷小隊裡。透過共同打贏一場小仗，強制他們建立社會信任。
speaker_notes.en: In M&A or DX, 'Subculture Friction' is lethal. The legacy manufacturing tribe worships 'Zero Defects'; the AI tribe worships 'Fail Fast.' Put them in a room, and they speak fundamentally incompatible sociological dialects. Here, C-Suite leaders must act as 'Professional Mediators.' We don't just mandate cooperation; we execute 'Contextual Translation' and lock them into Hybrid Squads. By surviving a high-pressure sprint together, we forcefully forge new social trust capital.

slide_title.zh: 制度慣性與心理安全感 (Institutional Inertia & Psychological Safety)

zh: 能力陷阱 (The Competency Trap)：組織會因為過去的成功而抗拒學習新技能。必須從社會學角度解構這種「沉沒成本謬誤 (Sunk Cost Fallacy)」
心理安全感 (Psychological Safety)：若文化中充滿「究責與獵巫」，員工將隱瞞錯誤。必須建立「無責備驗屍報告 (Blameless Post-mortem)」制度以鼓勵真實的創新
誘因重塑 (Incentive Rewiring)：人們的行為由社會評價決定。將「跨部門協作」與「知識分享」納入最高權重的年度考核，用結構改變文化
en: The Competency Trap: Organizations actively resist new paradigms because they are over-optimized for past successes. We must sociologically dismantle this 'Sunk Cost Fallacy.'
Psychological Safety: A culture defined by witch-hunts guarantees employees will hide critical failures. We must institutionalize 'Blameless Post-mortems' to unlock authentic innovation.

Incentive Rewiring: Human behavior conforms to social valuation. We are rewiring the reward structure, making 'Cross-Silo Collaboration' and 'Knowledge Sharing' the heaviest weighted metrics in annual reviews.

speaker_notes.zh: 社會學告訴我們，組織最大的敵人是『過去的成功』，這叫做『能力陷阱』。老員工不想學新系統，因為那會讓他們從專家變成菜鳥。要打破這種慣性，我們必須建立『心理安全感』。從今天起，做錯事不會被開除，只有『隱瞞錯誤』才會被開除。同時，我們要修改遊戲規則，把『幫助其他部門』列為升官的最重要指標。結構決定行為，行為決定文化。
speaker_notes.en: Sociology teaches us that an organization's deadliest enemy is its past success—the 'Competency Trap.' Veterans resist new systems because it demotes them from experts to novices. To shatter this inertia, we must mandate 'Psychological Safety.' Effective immediately, failure does not result in termination; 'hiding failure' does. Simultaneously, we are rewriting the game theory of our promotions: 'helping other departments' is now the fastest path to promotion. Structure dictates behavior; behavior dictates culture.

slide_title.zh: 100 天組織文化工程藍圖 (100-Day Cultural Engineering Blueprint)

zh: 第 1-30 天 (人類學診斷)：派遣外部診斷團隊進行深度訪談與無干預觀察 (Ethnography)，繪製企業真實的影子組織圖與次文化斷層線
第 31-100 天 (干預與調解)：啟動針對中高階主管的「跨部門調解與語境翻譯」工作坊，並正式發布全新綁定協作指標的 KPI 激勵體系
決策訴求 (Call to Action)：懇請董事會將「文化融合與社會資本建構」視為與資本支出同等重要的戰略投資，並授權 CHRO 主導本次文化重構手術
en: Days 1-30 (Anthropological Diagnostic): Deploying specialized diagnostic teams to conduct deep ethnography and unvarnished interviews, mapping the true Shadow Org Chart and subculture fault lines.

Days 31-100 (Intervention & Mediation): Launching mandatory 'Cross-Silo Mediation & Contextual Translation' workshops for leadership, and officially activating the new collaboration-weighted KPI incentive matrix.
Call to Action: Requesting the Board elevate 'Cultural Integration and Social Capital' to the exact same strategic priority as CapEx, authorizing the CHRO to lead this profound structural surgery.

speaker_notes.zh: 企業文化不是印在馬克杯上的標語，而是一場精密的社會學工程。前 30 天，我們不看報表，我們看『人』，把公司真實的權力網絡畫出來。接下來的 70 天，我們透過高壓的工作坊與調解機制，強迫不同部落的高管學會說同樣的語言，並把 KPI 的指揮棒交給這些新的行為準則。懇請董事會支持，讓我們從骨子裡，將這家公司打造成無法被擊敗的鐵軍。
speaker_notes.en: Corporate culture is not a slogan on a coffee mug; it is highly precise sociological engineering. The first 30 days, we ignore the balance sheet and observe the 'Humans,' charting the authentic power networks. The following 70 days, we use high-pressure mediation workshops to force warring executive tribes to speak a unified language, handing the baton to a rewired KPI matrix. I ask for the Board's full backing to fundamentally rebuild this enterprise into an invincible organism.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『企業人類學與權力動態戰略』簡報。受眾為董事會、CEO 或正經歷重大變革的高管團隊。內容必須展現 CHRO/社會學背景專家極度敏銳的組織洞察與調解手腕：1. 運用 SCQA 點出『文化把戰略當早餐吃』的痛點，及制度慣性對 ROI 的侵蝕，2. 導入『影子組織圖 (Shadow Org Chart)』概念，精準辨識非正式的文化意見領袖並加以招安，3. 運用社會學與高階調解 (Mediation) 視角，化解傳統部門與敏捷/AI部門間的次文化衝突，4. 探討能力陷阱、沉沒成本謬誤，並主張透過『無責備驗屍報告』建立心理安全感與重塑 KPI 誘因，5. 結尾給出 100 天人類學診斷與文化工程藍圖，要求董事會賦予絕對授權。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需充滿透視人性的智慧、打破砂鍋的犀利度與不容置疑的領導魄力。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Corporate Anthropology & Power Dynamics' presentation in English. Audience: Board of Directors, CEO, or Executive Team undergoing major transition. Demonstrate the hyper-perceptive organizational insight and mediation mastery of a CHRO with a Sociological background: 1. Use SCQA to frame how 'culture eats strategy for breakfast' and institutional inertia destroys ROI. 2. Introduce the 'Shadow Org Chart,' explicitly targeting informal Cultural Brokers for co-optation. 3. Deploy sociological and advanced Mediation lenses to neutralize subculture warfare between legacy units and agile/AI tribes. 4. Dissect the Competency Trap and Sunk Cost Fallacy, mandating 'Psychological Safety' and immediate KPI incentive rewiring. 5. Conclude with a 100-Day Anthropological Diagnostic & Cultural Engineering Blueprint, demanding absolute executive authorization. Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must project profound psychological wisdom, surgical analytical sharpness, and unquestionable leadership gravity.
